metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Fix Upper Trapezius Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows you how to quickly relieve upper trapezius muscle tightness and pain.

The upper trapezius is a common cause of discomfort at the base of the neck and the top of the shoulder. This pain is usually due to tightness and weakness in the muscle (and tendons).

To fix this, we’ll focus on exercises that help both lengthen and strengthen the muscle for fast and lasting relief.

For the best results, be sure to go through all the exercises and use the ones that provide the most relief.

As a bonus, all these exercises can be done at home and may provide quick upper back pain relief—sometimes in as little as 30 seconds

Watch now and get rid of your upper trapezius muscle pain for good!
